lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hi Reinaldo, it's Luis from the coaching program. Is now still a good time?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hi Luis. Give me one second... okay, I'm here.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Here's what I had in mind for today, but tell me if you'd rather focus on something else.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How's your body feeling this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Good. Busy, but good.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay, good.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Tell me how the vegetables went this week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: It didn't happen this week.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you think 5 days is realistic?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Well, sometimes. I don't know where the day goes.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Come on, you can find 10 minutes.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't really see the point.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're not sure it's worth it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm going to do it Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Does your family eat salad?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you mind if I tell you what some people do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Beans count too, and they keep you full.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How would things be different if you kept this up?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hmm, I have to think about that.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Just cut out the rice. That's the easiest thing.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay, this week I'll really do it. I feel guilty when I skip it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would your family say about these changes?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I feel better about myself when I stick to it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Where could the vegetables fit in your day?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I want to get my energy back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would make it easier next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll set an alarm on my phone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you buy frozen vegetables?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Let's put you down to add a vegetable to lunch and dinner on 3 days next week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: 10. Maybe 10.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What might get in the way?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll do it right when I wake up, before anything else.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Talk soon!

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thank you, talk soon.

tags.note: Commits to this week; expresses guilt
Feels better when sticking to it

flags.reason: Pressed participant ('Come on') after he named a time barrier instead of exploring it.
Directive advice to cut rice given without asking permission or exploring interest.
Participant voiced guilt about skipping; coach did not reflect or explore the feeling.
Set the 3-day goal for the participant without collaborative discussion; he responded 'I don't know'.

score.summary: Reinaldo showed clear change talk when he committed to specific days, a phone alarm, and a confidence rating of 10. However, the coach repeatedly pushed advice and set the goal without his input, and did not explore his guilt or feelings.
strengths: Line 18: asked permission before sharing what other people do.
Line 32: open question about what would make next week easier, eliciting a phone-alarm plan.
Line 41: used a 0-10 confidence scale, which surfaced strong self-efficacy.
coaching_tips: Line 12 and 24: replace 'Come on' and 'Just cut out the rice' with reflection and an open question about the time barrier.
Line 27: reflect the guilt ('It sounds like skipping weighs on you') before moving on.
Line 39: offer the goal as a question, e.g., 'What do you think would be a realistic number of days?'
Close with a summary of his commitments and a specific next contact date (line 45).
